author: SickProdigy
description: Prepare protected fixed-supply ERC-20 deployment drafts for Base Sepolia.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores public test-token deployment drafts linked to Discord user IDs and public wallet addresses. It never stores wallet keys, recovery material, or credentials.
install_msg: TokenFactory is a Base Sepolia-only draft prototype. Load CryptoWallet first. Use `[p]tokenfactory create` to open the token form. Contract deployment remains unavailable until an owner configures a reviewed and pinned factory contract.
short: Fixed-supply Base Sepolia token deployment drafts
